note: Synthetic demo configuration. Authorises an URGENT IN-APP notification (an application record and feed event, nothing else) to the supervisors granted the site when an operator asks for help, does not answer an offered check-in, or cannot be offered one. No email, SMS, phone call or emergency-service dispatch exists. A real site needs its own reviewed policy, recipients and timers before any use.

impact.basis: synthetic_demo_assumption: not a validated fall or man-down threshold

accelerated_demo.basis: isolated demo/test profile selected per process with COCOON_SOS_TIMER_PROFILE
